    start = txt.find(f"=== {name} ===")
    end = txt.find(f"=== End {name} ===")
    if start == -1 or end == -1:
        return ""
    return txt[start:end]

sec_inventory = extract_section("Warehouse Inventory")
sec_quality = extract_section("Quality Release")
sec_holds = extract_section("Dispatch Holds")
